faqs.q: What are the Dixon ground joint female spuds used for?
faqs.a: Dixon ground joint female spuds are the fixed half of a ground joint, with an NPT thread, in stainless steel. A hose stem is drawn up to the spud with a wing nut to make a metal-to-metal seal. This listing carries 5 part numbers.

faqs.q: What sizes and part numbers are listed for the Dixon ground joint female spuds?
faqs.a: The listing carries 5 part numbers, for example RGB13, RGB18 and RGB23, all with NPT threads and stainless steel bodies. The listing does not give the size of each row, so quote the part number or the pipe size when you enquire.

faqs.q: How should I select the Dixon ground joint female spuds for my application?
faqs.a: Choose the pipe size, the NPT thread, and the stem it must take. Stainless spuds should be paired with stainless stems and nuts so the joint keeps one material.

faqs.q: What working pressure applies to the Dixon ground joint female spuds?
faqs.a: No working pressure is published for the Dixon ground joint female spuds, so we do not quote one. A ground joint seals metal to metal and is used on steam, but the pressure you can use depends on the size, the hose and the clamp, so give us your working pressure and medium through [our contact page](/contact) and we confirm a figure before you order.

faqs.q: Which materials are the Dixon ground joint female spuds offered in?
faqs.a: The Dixon female spuds are stainless steel with an NPT thread, according to the listing. Stainless steel suits wet and corrosive areas where plated iron would corrode.

faqs.q: Which standards and documents apply to the Dixon ground joint female spuds?
faqs.a: The listing names no ISO, ASME or EN standard and holds no certificates for the Dixon ground joint female spuds. Ground joint is a long-established pattern and parts must match in size and seat form, not a stated standard. If your project needs a material or conformity certificate, say so in the enquiry and we ask the maker. See [our ground joint steam coupling guide](/blog/ground-joint-steam-couplings) for the pattern.

faqs.q: What do the Dixon ground joint female spuds connect to?
faqs.a: The NPT female thread takes a male pipe nipple, and the spud face takes a stem drawn up with a wing nut. See [the Dixon ground joint stems](/p/dixon-ground-joint-stems) for the hose half.

faqs.q: How do I fit and look after the Dixon ground joint female spuds?
faqs.a: On the Dixon ground joint female spuds, keep the ground seats clean and undamaged, because a scratched seat leaks. Draw the joint up with the wing nut, clamp the hose to the stem with a clamp sized to the hose outside diameter, and re-tighten after the first heat cycle. No gasket is used, so there is nothing to renew except the parts themselves.

faqs.q: Where are the Dixon ground joint female spuds used?
faqs.a: Ground joint couplings are used on steam, air and water hose in plants, boiler houses, shipyards and construction, where a metal-to-metal joint is wanted because rubber seals harden and fail in steam. The Dixon ground joint female spuds are one part of that joint.

faqs.q: How do the Dixon ground joint female spuds differ from the Dixon washer seal spud?
faqs.a: The female spud makes a metal-to-metal joint with a ground stem, while [the Dixon washer seal spud](/p/dixon-washer-seal-spud) is a washer-seal spud that uses a washer to seal the joint. Both are stainless with an NPT thread; pick by the seat type of the stem.

faqs.a: We ship the Dixon ground joint female spuds from our Dubai, UAE warehouse to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond. The country of origin on this listing is United States. Export documents come with the order; ask on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Are the Dixon ground joint female spuds available from stock in Dubai for export?
faqs.a: Yes. We stock the Dixon ground joint female spuds at our Dubai, UAE warehouse and send it worldwide with the best lead times. Tell us the models and quantities on [our contact page](/contact) and we will quote.
